coverage.notes: 170 complete region-date rows. Four article-period dates lack derivable public daily outcomes; no coverage relaxation was made.

blockers: The reconstructed panel has only two regional clusters (Lombardia and Veneto); cluster-robust GEE inference is not defensible with two clusters.
The long-term SO2 predictor has only two region-level values, so its principal between-region comparison is based on two exposure groups.
The publicly archived regional outcome series begins 2020-02-24; daily incident outcomes can only be derived from 2020-02-25, leaving four of the article's 89 target dates unavailable.
